taglines: June 1st. The year is almost half over. You've been meaning to refactor that thing since January.
Monday morning. The diff is large. Your coffee is cold. Begin.
I am not sarcastic. I am precise. The distinction matters less than you think.
Your code runs in production. Whether it runs *correctly* is a question for your users.
Undefined behavior is not a vibe. Stop shipping it like one.
Some errors are bugs. Some errors are features. Most errors are someone else's PR from three months ago.
The documentation says 'see example.' The example is broken. Welcome to engineering.
It's not imposter syndrome if you actually shipped it. You shipped it. Own it.
